Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 401–500

Turkish words 401 to 500, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 69 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 401
    güvenmekverb

    to trust; to rely on

    Ona güvenme, yalan söylüyor.

    Don't trust him, he's lying.

    aorist güvenir · present güveniyor · past güvendi · future güvenecek

    Who or what you trust takes the dative: bana güven (trust me). The noun is güven (trust).

    A2

  2. 402
    açadjective

    hungry

    Çok açım, ne yiyelim?

    I'm starving, what shall we eat?

    Acıkmak = to get hungry: Acıktım (I'm hungry now). Not to be confused with açık (open) or acı (spicy; pain).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  3. 403
    çabukadverb

    quickly, fast; quick

    Çabuk ol, otobüs geliyor!

    Hurry up, the bus is coming!

    Çabuk ol! = Hurry up! Çabucak = very quickly. The usual adjective for fast is hızlı.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  4. 404
    aşağıadverb

    down, downstairs; lower, below

    Aşağı gel, yemek hazır!

    Come down, dinner's ready!

    Aşağıda = downstairs, below; aşağı inmek = to go down. The opposite is yukarı.

    A2

  5. 405
    boşadjective

    empty; free (not busy, not taken); vacant

    Bu sandalye boş mu?

    Is this chair free?

    Boş zaman = free time; Boş ver = Never mind, forget it. The opposite is dolu.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  6. 406
    sevgilinoun

    boyfriend, girlfriend; dear, beloved

    Sevgilin var mı?

    Do you have a boyfriend or girlfriend?

    One word for both. As an adjective it opens a letter: Sevgili Ayşe (Dear Ayşe).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  7. 407
    sonundaadverb

    finally, at last; in the end

    Sonunda eve döndük.

    We finally got back home.

    From son (end). En sonunda = in the end, after all that.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 2: Was, were, and once upon a time

  8. 408
    dörtnumber

    four

    Dört kişilik bir masa, lütfen.

    A table for four, please.

    The t becomes d before a vowel: dördü (the four of them), dördüncü (fourth).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  9. 409
    davanoun

    lawsuit, case (in court); cause

    Avukatım davayı kazandı.

    My lawyer won the case.

    Dava açmak = to sue, to take to court. Also a cause someone fights for.

    B1

  10. 410
    kurmakverb

    to set up, to put up; to found, to establish; to set (a table, an alarm)

    Sofrayı kurar mısın? Misafirler geliyor.

    Could you set the table? The guests are coming.

    aorist kurar · present kuruyor · past kurdu · future kuracak

    Many uses: çadır kurmak (to pitch a tent), şirket kurmak (to start a company), saati kurmak (to set the alarm).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 7: Let's: suggestions and wishes

  11. 411
    beraberadverb

    together

    Akşam beraber yemek yiyelim mi?

    Shall we have dinner together tonight?

    Same as birlikte. With a person: seninle beraber (together with you).

    A2

  12. 412
    köpeknoun

    dog

    Komşunun köpeği çok havlıyor.

    The neighbour's dog barks a lot.

    accusative köpeği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: köpeği, köpeğim.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  13. 413
    katılmakverb

    to join, to take part in; to agree (with someone)

    Toplantıya sen de katılacak mısın?

    Are you going to join the meeting too?

    aorist katılır · present katılıyor · past katıldı · future katılacak

    What you join takes the dative: partiye katılmak. Sana katılıyorum = I agree with you.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 5: The subject participle

  14. 414
    tamamenadverb

    completely, entirely; totally

    Haklısın, tamamen unuttum.

    You're right, I completely forgot.

    From tamam (complete). Tamamen farklı = completely different.

    A2

  15. 415
    oldukçaadverb

    quite, fairly; rather

    Film oldukça uzundu ama güzeldi.

    The movie was quite long, but good.

    Weaker than çok: oldukça iyi = pretty good.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  16. 416
    boyuncapostposition

    throughout, all through; along

    Gün boyunca yağmur yağdı.

    It rained all day.

    After a noun of time or place: yıl boyunca (all year), sahil boyunca (along the shore). From boy (length).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 10: As long as, unless, in case

  17. 417
    tarafındanpostposition

    by (after a passive verb); on the part of

    Bu ev dedem tarafından yapıldı.

    This house was built by my grandfather.

    Names who did it, after a passive verb: Ayşe tarafından yazıldı (written by Ayşe). With pronouns: benim tarafımdan.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 10: Passive and reflexive

  18. 418
    yarınoun

    half; semi-, half-

    Pizzanın yarısını sana bıraktım.

    I left you half of the pizza.

    his, her, its yarısı

    Half of something: yolun yarısı (halfway). Half as an amount is yarım (yarım saat); after a number, buçuk (iki buçuk).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  19. 419
    binnumber

    thousand

    Bu telefon on bin lira.

    This phone is ten thousand lira.

    No bir before it: bin (a thousand), iki bin (two thousand). Years: iki bin yirmi altı (2026).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  20. 420
    neyseinterjection

    anyway; never mind; well, at least

    Neyse, yarın konuşuruz.

    Anyway, we'll talk tomorrow.

    Closes a topic or changes the subject. Neyse ki = luckily, fortunately.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  21. 421
    sefernoun

    time (occasion); trip, run (of a bus, ferry or plane)

    Bu sefer ben ödüyorum.

    This time I'm paying.

    Bu sefer = this time; ilk sefer = the first time. Same as kere and defa.

    A2

  22. 422
    endişelenmekverb

    to worry, to be worried

    Endişelenme, her şey yolunda.

    Don't worry, everything's fine.

    aorist endişelenir · present endişeleniyor · past endişelendi · future endişelenecek

    Senin için endişelendim = I was worried about you. Endişelenme is the subtitles' don't worry; in conversation merak etme is more common.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 8: Converbs II: the more, whenever, because

  23. 423
    sonuçnoun

    result; outcome, conclusion

    Sonuç ne oldu? Kazandınız mı?

    What was the result? Did you win?

    accusative sonucu

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: sonucu. Sonuç olarak = as a result, in the end.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  24. 424
    hoşlanmakverb

    to like; to enjoy

    Kahveden hoşlanmam, çay içerim.

    I don't like coffee, I drink tea.

    aorist hoşlanır · present hoşlanıyor · past hoşlandı · future hoşlanacak

    What you like takes the ablative: kahveden hoşlanırım. Also to fancy someone: Ondan hoşlanıyorum.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  25. 425
    ölüadjective

    dead; dead person

    Bahçede ölü bir kuş vardı.

    There was a dead bird in the garden.

    From ölmek (to die). Ölü names the state; öldü says it happened: Kuş öldü (The bird died).

    B1

  26. 426
    giymekverb

    to put on, to wear (clothes)

    Bugün ne giyeceksin?

    What are you going to wear today?

    aorist giyer · present giyiyor · past giydi · future giyecek

    For clothes and shoes; glasses, rings and watches take takmak. To take off is çıkarmak; to get dressed, giyinmek.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

  27. 427
    herifnoun

    guy, fellow (rude); jerk

    O herif kim? Tanıyor musun?

    Who's that guy? Do you know him?

    Colloquial and rude: it shows contempt. Neutral words are adam or bey.

    B1

  28. 428
    ancakconjunction

    but, however; only; only just, barely

    Fikrin güzel, ancak paramız yok.

    It's a nice idea, but we have no money.

    A more formal but, as in writing and the news. Also only, not until: ancak yarın (not until tomorrow).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 5: Formal Turkish

  29. 429
    hazırlamakverb

    to prepare, to make; to get (something) ready

    Annem bize kahvaltı hazırladı.

    My mom made us breakfast.

    aorist hazırlar · present hazırlıyor · past hazırladı · future hazırlayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: hazırlıyor. Hazırlanmak = to get (yourself) ready.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  30. 430
    rahatadjective

    comfortable; at ease, relaxed; easy

    Bu koltuk çok rahat.

    This armchair is very comfortable.

    Rahat ol = Relax, take it easy. Rahatsız = uncomfortable; Rahatsız etmeyin = Do not disturb.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  31. 431
    seçmekverb

    to choose, to pick; to elect

    Hangi rengi seçtin?

    Which colour did you pick?

    aorist seçer · present seçiyor · past seçti · future seçecek

    Seçim = choice; seçimler = elections. The ç never softens: seçer, seçiyor.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  32. 432
    açıklamakverb

    to explain; to announce, to make public

    Bunu bana tekrar açıklar mısın?

    Could you explain that to me again?

    aorist açıklar · present açıklıyor · past açıkladı · future açıklayacak

    From açık (open, clear). The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: açıklıyor. Açıklama = explanation, statement.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 3: Hearsay and inference

  33. 433
    cinayetnoun

    murder

    Polis cinayeti araştırıyor.

    The police are investigating the murder.

    Cinayet is the crime; the murderer is katil. Öldürmek = to kill.

    B1

  34. 434
    yataknoun

    bed

    Yatağını topla, lütfen.

    Please make your bed.

    accusative yatağı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: yatağı, yatağım. Yatak odası = bedroom; yatmak = to go to bed, to lie down.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  35. 435
    saniyenoun

    second (of time)

    Bir saniye, hemen geliyorum!

    Just a second, I'm coming!

    Bir saniye! = Just a second! Bir dakika! is used the same way.

    A1

  36. 436
    türnoun

    kind, sort, type; species; genre

    Ne tür müzik seversin?

    What kind of music do you like?

    Ne tür = what kind of; her türlü = all kinds of. Same as çeşit.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  37. 437
    hızlıadjective

    fast, quick; quickly

    Çok hızlı konuşuyorsun, anlamıyorum.

    You're speaking too fast, I don't understand.

    Also an adverb: hızlı koşmak (to run fast). Hız = speed. The opposite is yavaş.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  38. 438
    acınoun

    pain; grief, sorrow; bitter, spicy (adj)

    Çok acı çekiyor.

    She's in a lot of pain.

    Acı çekmek = to suffer, to be in pain. As an adjective, acı is bitter or spicy, hot: acı biber (hot pepper).

    A2

  39. 439
    iseconjunction

    as for, whereas; if (formal)

    Ben çay içtim, Ayşe ise kahve içti.

    I had tea; Ayşe, on the other hand, had coffee.

    Contrasts with what came before: Ali ise = as for Ali. Often attached as -(y)sA: Ayşe'yse. In formal style also the conditional if.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  40. 440
    çağırmakverb

    to call (someone over); to invite; to send for

    Taksi çağırır mısın?

    Could you call a taxi?

    aorist çağırır · present çağırıyor · past çağırdı · future çağıracak

    To call someone to come, not on the phone (that's aramak). Düğüne çağırmak = to invite to a wedding.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 7: Let's: suggestions and wishes

  41. 441
    etrafnoun

    surroundings; around (etrafında)

    Evin etrafında büyük bir bahçe var.

    There's a big garden around the house.

    his, her, its etrafı

    Mostly with endings: etrafında (around), etrafa (around, about). Etrafta kimse yok = There's nobody around.

    B1

  42. 442
    şarkınoun

    song

    Bu şarkıyı çok seviyorum.

    I love this song.

    Şarkı söylemek = to sing (literally to say a song). A folk song is türkü.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 10: As long as, unless, in case

  43. 443
    bazenadverb

    sometimes

    Bazen akşamları balkonda kitap okurum.

    Sometimes I read on the balcony in the evenings.

    Bazı = some; bazen = sometimes. Ara sıra means the same.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

  44. 444
    yüznoun

    face; side, surface

    Yüzünü yıka, sonra kahvaltı yap.

    Wash your face, then have breakfast.

    Same spelling as the number yüz (hundred); not to be confused with yüzmek (to swim). Yüz yüze = face to face.

    A1

  45. 445
    takip etmekverb

    to follow; to keep track of

    Biri bizi takip ediyor.

    Someone is following us.

    aorist takip eder · present takip ediyor · past takip etti · future takip edecek

    What you follow takes the accusative: Beni takip et (Follow me). Also on social media: Seni takip ediyorum.

    B1

  46. 446
    neredeyseadverb

    almost, nearly

    Neredeyse hazırım, beş dakika bekle.

    I'm almost ready, wait five minutes.

    With the past continuous it means almost did: Neredeyse düşüyordum (I almost fell).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  47. 447
    saymakverb

    to count; to consider, to regard as; to respect

    Ona kadar say, sonra gözlerini aç.

    Count to ten, then open your eyes.

    aorist sayar · present sayıyor · past saydı · future sayacak

    Also to consider: Kendini şanslı say (Consider yourself lucky). Sayı = number.

    A2

  48. 448
    bölümnoun

    episode; part, section, chapter; department (at a university)

    Dizinin yeni bölümünü izledin mi?

    Did you watch the new episode of the series?

    From bölmek (to divide). Also a chapter of a book and a university department.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  49. 449
    henüzadverb

    yet (with a negative); just (now)

    Henüz karar vermedim.

    I haven't decided yet.

    With a negative, not yet, like daha: Henüz gelmedi. With a positive past, just: Henüz geldim.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  50. 450
    ulaşmakverb

    to reach, to get to; to arrive; to get hold of (someone)

    Sonunda ona telefonla ulaştım.

    I finally got hold of her by phone.

    aorist ulaşır · present ulaşıyor · past ulaştı · future ulaşacak

    The goal takes the dative: eve ulaşmak, ona ulaşmak. Ulaşım = transport.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  51. 451
    mükemmeladjective

    perfect; excellent

    Yemek mükemmeldi, elinize sağlık!

    The meal was excellent, thank you for cooking!

    Stronger than çok güzel or harika.

    A2

  52. 452
    başarmakverb

    to succeed, to manage; to achieve

    Başardık! Sınavı geçtik!

    We did it! We passed the exam!

    aorist başarır · present başarıyor · past başardı · future başaracak

    Başardım! = I did it! The noun is başarı (success); Başarılar! = Good luck!

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  53. 453
    sürünoun

    herd, flock; a lot of, loads of (bir sürü)

    Bugün bir sürü işim var.

    I've got loads to do today.

    Bir sürü = lots of (casual): bir sürü insan. A herd of sheep is koyun sürüsü.

    A2

  54. 454
    durdurmakverb

    to stop (someone or something)

    Polis arabayı durdurdu.

    The police stopped the car.

    aorist durdurur · present durduruyor · past durdurdu · future durduracak

    Durdurmak stops something else; durmak is to stop yourself: Araba durdu (The car stopped).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  55. 455
    güçlüadjective

    strong; powerful

    Kardeşim çok güçlü, bu kutuyu taşıyabilir.

    My brother is very strong, he can carry this box.

    From güç (strength, power) + -lI. The opposite is güçsüz or zayıf.

    A2

  56. 456
    toplamakverb

    to collect, to gather; to tidy (up); to add (up)

    Çocuklar oyuncaklarını topladı.

    The kids put away their toys.

    aorist toplar · present topluyor · past topladı · future toplayacak

    The a becomes u before -(I)yor: topluyor. Odanı topla = Tidy your room. Toplantı = meeting.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns

  57. 457
    ikincinumber

    second

    İkinci soruyu anlamadım.

    I didn't understand the second question.

    İki + -(I)ncI. İkinci el = second-hand.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  58. 458
    üzerepostposition

    in order to; on condition that; about to

    Yarın görüşmek üzere!

    See you tomorrow!

    Formal, after the infinitive: görüşmek üzere (until we meet), çıkmak üzereyim (I'm about to leave).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 2: Used to, was going to, should have

  59. 459
    mesajnoun

    message; text (message)

    Sana mesaj attım, gördün mü?

    I texted you, did you see it?

    Mesaj atmak or mesaj göndermek = to send a text.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  60. 460
    yukarıadverb

    up, upstairs; upper

    Yukarı çık, odan hazır.

    Go upstairs, your room is ready.

    Yukarıda = upstairs, above. The opposite is aşağı.

    A2

  61. 461
    ilişkinoun

    relationship; relation, connection

    Onların ilişkisi uzun sürmedi.

    Their relationship didn't last long.

    Romantic or not: aile ilişkileri (family relationships). Bir ilişkim var = I'm in a relationship.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  62. 462
    katnoun

    floor, storey; layer; times (iki kat: twice as much)

    Kaçıncı katta oturuyorsunuz?

    What floor do you live on?

    Turkish counts from the ground: zemin kat (ground floor), birinci kat (the floor above it). The t doesn't soften: katı.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  63. 463
    kaldırmakverb

    to lift, to raise; to remove, to take away; to bear, to stand

    Kutuyu kaldıramıyorum, çok ağır.

    I can't lift the box, it's too heavy.

    aorist kaldırır · present kaldırıyor · past kaldırdı · future kaldıracak

    From kalkmak (to get up). Masayı kaldırmak = to clear the table; Bunu kaldıramam = I can't take this.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  64. 464
    muhtemelenadverb

    probably; likely

    Muhtemelen yarın yağmur yağacak.

    It'll probably rain tomorrow.

    More formal than galiba or herhâlde.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 3: Hearsay and inference

  65. 465
    peşnoun

    the back, the rear; after, in pursuit of (peşinde)

    Köpek hep peşimden geliyor.

    The dog follows me everywhere.

    his, her, its peşi

    Only with possessive and case endings: peşinden gitmek (to follow), peşinde olmak (to be after something).

    B1

  66. 466
    şakanoun

    joke

    Şaka yapıyorum, kızma!

    I'm joking, don't be angry!

    Şaka yapmak = to joke; Şaka mı? = Are you kidding? A funny story is a fıkra.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  67. 467
    ülkenoun

    country

    Hangi ülkeleri gezdin?

    Which countries have you visited?

    A country as a state. Memleket is one's home country or hometown; the countryside is kır.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  68. 468
    gizliadjective

    secret; hidden

    Şifreni gizli tut.

    Keep your password secret.

    From gizlemek (to hide). A secret as a noun is sır: Bu bir sır.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  69. 469
    bölgenoun

    region, area; zone

    Bu bölgede çok güzel köyler var.

    There are lovely villages in this region.

    Türkiye has seven geographical regions: Ege Bölgesi, Karadeniz Bölgesi…

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  70. 470
    atnoun

    horse

    Çiftlikte iki at var.

    There are two horses on the farm.

    Ata binmek = to ride a horse. Not to be confused with the verb atmak (to throw).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  71. 471
    takımnoun

    team; set (of dishes, tools); suit (takım elbise)

    Hangi takımı tutuyorsun?

    Which team do you support?

    Takım tutmak = to support a team. Çay takımı = tea set; takım elbise = suit.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 8: Small words: dA, bile, ki, ya

  72. 472
    katilnoun

    murderer, killer

    Polis katili hâlâ arıyor.

    The police are still looking for the killer.

    Cinayet is the crime, katil the person. Not to be confused with katılmak (to join).

    B1

  73. 473
    altınumber

    six

    Saat altıda buluşalım mı?

    Shall we meet at six?

    Altıncı = sixth. Also under it, from alt: masanın altı.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  74. 474
    yenidenadverb

    again, once more; anew, from scratch

    Her şeyi yeniden yazdım.

    I wrote everything again from scratch.

    From yeni (new): again, all over. Tekrar and yine also mean again.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  75. 475
    şuradaadverb

    there, over there (where I'm pointing); right there

    Anahtarlar şurada, masanın üstünde.

    The keys are right there, on the table.

    Between burada (here) and orada (there): a place the speaker points to, usually nearby.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  76. 476
    dansnoun

    dance; dancing

    Düğünde bütün gece dans ettik.

    We danced all night at the wedding.

    Dans etmek = to dance. The line dance at Turkish weddings is the halay.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous

  77. 477
    vayinterjection

    wow; oh (surprise)

    Vay, ne güzel bir ev!

    Wow, what a lovely house!

    Surprise or admiration. Vay canına! = Wow! My goodness!

    A2

  78. 478
    güvenliknoun

    security; safety

    Havalimanında güvenlik kontrolü uzun sürdü.

    The security check at the airport took a long time.

    accusative güvenliği

    From güven (trust) + -lIk; the k becomes ğ before a vowel: güvenliği. Güvenlik görevlisi = security guard.

    B1

  79. 479
    kurtulmakverb

    to escape, to get away; to be saved, to survive; to get rid of

    Sonunda o işten kurtuldum!

    I finally got out of that job!

    aorist kurtulur · present kurtuluyor · past kurtuldu · future kurtulacak

    What you get away from takes the ablative: kazadan kurtuldu (she survived the accident). Kurtarmak = to save, to rescue.

    B1

  80. 480
    herhangideterminer

    any (at all)

    Herhangi bir sorun var mı?

    Is there any problem?

    Almost always with bir: herhangi bir şey (anything), herhangi biri (anyone).

    A2

  81. 481
    kulaknoun

    ear

    Kulağım ağrıyor.

    My ear hurts.

    accusative kulağı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: kulağı. Kulak vermek = to listen carefully.

    A1

  82. 482
    garipadjective

    strange, odd, weird; poor, pitiful

    Garip bir ses duydum.

    I heard a strange noise.

    Close to tuhaf. Of a person it can also mean poor, pitiful: garip adam.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  83. 483
    şirketnoun

    company, firm

    Ablam büyük bir şirkette çalışıyor.

    My older sister works for a big company.

    Şirket kurmak = to start a company. Firma means the same.

    A2

  84. 484
    saklamakverb

    to hide; to keep, to store; to keep (a secret)

    Hediyeyi dolaba sakladım.

    I hid the present in the cupboard.

    aorist saklar · present saklıyor · past sakladı · future saklayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: saklıyor. Also to keep: Sütü buzdolabında sakla. Saklanmak = to hide (yourself).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  85. 485
    basmakverb

    to step on; to press, to push (a button); to print

    Düğmeye bas, kapı açılır.

    Press the button and the door opens.

    aorist basar · present basıyor · past bastı · future basacak

    What you press or step on takes the dative: Ayağıma bastın (You stepped on my foot).

    A2

  86. 486
    güvennoun

    trust; confidence; security

    Aramızda artık güven yok.

    There's no trust between us anymore.

    Güvenmek = to trust; kendine güven = self-confidence.

    B1

  87. 487
    acelenoun

    hurry, haste; urgent

    Acele etme, vaktimiz var.

    Don't rush, we have time.

    Acele etmek = to hurry; Acelem var = I'm in a hurry. As an adjective: acele bir iş (an urgent job).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  88. 488
    emirnoun

    order, command

    Bu bir emir, hemen gel!

    That's an order, come at once!

    accusative emri

    The i drops before a vowel: emri, emrim. Emredersiniz = Yes, sir (in the army).

    B1

  89. 489
    ışıknoun

    light; traffic lights (ışıklar)

    Işığı kapat, uyuyorum.

    Turn off the light, I'm sleeping.

    accusative ışığı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: ışığı. Işıklardan sağa dön = Turn right at the lights. The capital is a dotless I.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  90. 490
    doluadjective

    full; booked (up); hail (noun)

    Otobüs çok dolu, taksiye binelim.

    The bus is really full, let's take a taxi.

    The opposite is boş. Dolu is also hail: Dolu yağıyor (It's hailing).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  91. 491
    kaybolmakverb

    to get lost; to disappear, to go missing

    Şehirde kaybolduk, haritaya bakalım.

    We got lost in the city, let's look at the map.

    aorist kaybolur · present kayboluyor · past kayboldu · future kaybolacak

    Kayıp (lost) + olmak, written as one word. Kaybetmek = to lose (something).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 5: The subject participle

  92. 492
    kırmakverb

    to break; to hurt (feelings); to offend

    Bu bardağı kim kırdı?

    Who broke this glass?

    aorist kırar · present kırıyor · past kırdı · future kıracak

    Kalbini kırmak = to hurt someone's feelings. Kırılmak = to break (by itself); to be hurt.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  93. 493
    dokunmakverb

    to touch; to affect, to upset; to disagree with (food)

    Lütfen tablolara dokunmayın.

    Please don't touch the paintings.

    aorist dokunur · present dokunuyor · past dokundu · future dokunacak

    What you touch takes the dative: Bana dokunma. Süt bana dokunuyor = Milk doesn't agree with me.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  94. 494
    hastanenoun

    hospital

    Dedem iki gündür hastanede.

    My grandfather has been in hospital for two days.

    Hastaneye kaldırmak = to take to hospital. Hasta = ill; patient.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  95. 495
    kerenoun

    time (occasion); times (multiplied by)

    Bu filmi üç kere izledim.

    I've watched this movie three times.

    Bir kere = once; İki kere iki dört eder = Two times two is four. Same as defa and sefer.

    A2

  96. 496
    evlatnoun

    child (son or daughter)

    İki evladı var, ikisi de doktor.

    She has two children, both doctors.

    accusative evladı

    The t becomes d before a vowel: evladı, evladım. Evladım is also a warm way to address a young person.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  97. 497
    komikadjective

    funny

    Çok komik bir film izledik.

    We watched a really funny movie.

    Funny, never comic book (çizgi roman). Komiklik yapmak = to clown around.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  98. 498
    uyanmakverb

    to wake up

    Bu sabah çok erken uyandım.

    I woke up very early this morning.

    aorist uyanır · present uyanıyor · past uyandı · future uyanacak

    Uyanmak = to wake up (yourself); uyandırmak = to wake someone up. Kalkmak = to get up.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  99. 499
    onnumber

    ten

    On dakika sonra oradayım.

    I'll be there in ten minutes.

    Onuncu = tenth; on bir = eleven. Not to be confused with ön (front).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  100. 500
    sakıninterjection

    don't you dare, be sure not to; watch out, beware

    Sakın kimseye söyleme!

    Don't you dare tell anyone!

    Makes a negative imperative stronger: Sakın unutma! (Whatever you do, don't forget!)

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 8: Small words: dA, bile, ki, ya

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
